pages.text: Villages arm $(bold)Guard Villagers$() to hold a wall: hand a villager a sword or crossbow and they take the post. $(bold)Recruits$() are soldiers you hire and own: command them with $(bold)R$() and teams with $(bold)U$().
Recruits follow, hold, patrol and guard. They die for good, so give them armour. Pay is emeralds per hire.

Hiring is $(bold)locked$() until the Mutant Skeleton falls: the drill that made soldiers of farmers was lost with it ($(l:patchouli:tech/tier1)Tier 1$()). Guards are not locked; a wall can always be manned.$(br2)$(bold)Hiring:$() right-click a recruit with emeralds in hand; the price is on the screen. Shift-right-click one for his own screen: inventory, equipment, upkeep.

$(bold)Food is how they heal.$() A recruit has a hunger bar like yours; a full belly heals him fast, an empty one not at all. Fighting and healing make him hungry; standing and marching do not. A loaf of bread is worth about seven hit points.$(br2)Cooked food heals faster than raw.

At a quarter health a recruit with food in his pack breaks off, eats, and goes back in. One with an empty pack fights on. The $(bold)Hold the line$() button on his screen stops him ever withdrawing: for the man on the gate.$(br2)Starving never kills a recruit; it leaves him useless until fed. They gain levels and better aim with experience.
